subject: general
question:
What will come in the place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘–’ are interchanged and also ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

11 ÷ 12 – 78 × 6 + 54 = ?
solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

Given equation: 11 ÷ 12 – 78 × 6 + 54 = ?

Now, if ‘+’ and ‘–’ and also ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ 11 × 12 + __**78 ÷ 6**__ - 54 = ?
